description: This file contains shell script commands for testing and verifying Git checkout functionalities, including branch creation, switching, conflict scenarios, and remote branch management.

methods.name: test_branch
methods.description: Checks if the current branch matches the specified branch reference.

methods.name: test_branch_upstream
methods.description: Verifies if the local branch is set to pull from the specified remote and branch.

methods.name: status_uno_is_clean
methods.description: Checks if the working directory is clean (no changes).
